description: The σ_1 projection of {0, 1, ζ_7, ζ_7^2, …, ζ_7^6} from Z[ζ_7]'s Minkowski lattice: 7 unit-circle vertices plus the origin. Produces 7 spoke unit-distance pairs (center↔vertex); no vertex-vertex pairs are unit (closest chord is 2sin(π/7) ≈ 0.868). Demonstrates the Q(ζ_7) chain end-to-end but does NOT itself achieve density exponent > 1.
name: heptagon-with-center

description: Four vertices of an axis-aligned unit square. Note: only 4 of 6 pairs are unit; the diagonals are sqrt(2).
name: unit-square

description: Three vertices of an equilateral triangle with side 1.
name: unit-triangle
